<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market performance and drivers:</strong> Indian indices are trading near the flat line as robust Q1 earnings and sustained FII buying provide a floor, even as markets face selling pressure and volatility from rising Brent crude prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOV1dmOHdNaXhabi01UkhQWkFDSS1KeUNLaXhDbVJUSHFfaDQ1ZGNwVnVSQnY5SzRrcTkxcVA4aktXdkgtSktXQjBoRXZWUEc3ZmM5Z0Fta1Y1TldQWjJJNkVDckVpWDNJNWdXakFWbFcyaFFsWWIxZVlUdzJjbzdFVDlIbDRCYldqcTlKcnJkN0RpTFVUNkxEMk9XSGNvLWNYVGZnZ1g3Zy0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Index rejig:</strong> The Nifty September 2026 rebalancing will see Wipro exit the index, with BSE set to be included, alongside changes to the Nifty Next 50 involving BHEL, Polycab, and Vedanta Aluminium.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>
